{{Top}}
[[File:Groomed_Chewie.jpg|thumb|200px|The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] from [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] were a very hairy species.]]
{{Quote|I certainly don't understand the obsession with hair the women around here seem to have.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="Diaries">{{Tales|11|The Princess Leia Diaries}}</ref>}}
'''Hair''' was a part of the anatomy that grew all over the body on many creatures and beings, mostly [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]] (like the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] or the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]]) and [[Reptomammal/Legends|reptomammalian]] (like the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] or the [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]]) [[Species/Legends|species]]. The thick coat of hair that grew on certain species was also called '''fur'''. [[Human/Legends|Humans]], the dominant [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], grew hair in all manner of places except the soles of their feet and the palms of their hands. Other species like the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] were fully covered with a thick coat of hair.

Hair came in a great variety of thicknesses, lengths, and [[Color/Legends|colors]], but usually lost its hue with old age. As it was made of a living material, all hair would grow and fall when the cells died. In younger beings, soon after the cells died, new ones grew again in the same place, making new hair. In some beings, the regrowth process became less efficient with old age, eventually leading to baldness.

==Function==
[[File:Oppo.jpg|thumb|left|170px|The [[Thisspiasian/Legends|Thisspiasians]]' thick hair and beard protected their faces from aggressions.]]
Hairedness seems to have been a [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]] trait. Most mammals had hair or fur that served different functions&mdash;though body hair, such as that on [[Human/Legends|Humans]], could be extremely fine.<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref> Hair notably provided thermal regulation, which was necessary on icy [[Planet/Legends|planets]] like [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] or [[Toola/Legends|Toola]], which was why the [[Wampa/Legends|Wampa]] and [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] sported fur all over their bodies. Sometimes hair had defensive functions. The [[Thisspiasian/Legends|Thisspiasian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] would grow thick beards to deter the local [[Cygnat/Legends|cygnat]] bites.<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>

Many other species (most [[Reptavian/Legends|reptavians]], [[Bird/Legends|birds]] and [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]]) were normally hairless. The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], for example, were typically hairless, but some would grow beards or locks due to a rare genetic mutation.<ref name="HHH">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030911hutt|text=Hutt! Hutt! Hutt!}}</ref>

Somewhere between the two extremes lay certain [[Reptomammal/Legends|reptomammals]] who shared the mammalian species' hairedness. Among them were the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] from [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|the eponymous planet]] or the [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssins]] from [[Byss/Legends|Byss]]. Other reptommmals, like the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]] and the [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdites]], were completely hairless.<ref name="NEGAS" />

==Social role==
{{Quote|I suggest that we find you a suitable gown and gems. And perhaps a hair stylist.''"<br />"''I'm a pilot. Appearances aren't important to what I do.''"<br />"''That's quite apparent.|[[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and [[Ta'a Chume]]|<ref name="NJO:DJ">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Journey]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Amidala_hair_tending.png|thumb|180px|Padmé Amidala's hair being tended to by her [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaidens]]]]
Haired species would often cut or arrange the hair on their head in a way considered aesthetically pleasing or acceptable. On [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], for example, the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|queens]] wore very intricate hairstyles, some of which necessitated [[Wig/Legends|wigs]] or hair extensions.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> Young [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] used to think the women of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] had an obssession with their hair, a fixation she herself did not share.<ref name="Diaries" /> A popular hairstyle among Human females consisted of coiling the hair in twin buns. Throughout history, many famous women were known to sport their hair in this fashion, including [[Liana Merian/Legends|Liana Merian]],<ref name="Episode I: The Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]],<ref name="Spy Girls">{{CWACite|7|Spy Girls}}</ref> [[Delva Racine/Legends|Delva Racine]],<ref name="SWCP">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> and Leia Organa.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> Some [[One Sith]], like [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Darth Krayt|Krayt]], and [[Darth Maladi]] would wear their hair long.<ref name="Legacy 2006 15">[[Legacy (2006) 15|''Legacy'' (2006) 15]]</ref>

Some Humans, like [[Andronikos Revel]] or [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], chose to shave the hair from their head completely. At the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], this was quite common in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] military, even among [[Gender/Legends|female]] officers.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

During the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], many male officers of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] grew long sideburns (as exemplified by [[Moradmin Bast/Legends|Moradmin Bast]] or [[Pol Treidum/Legends|Pol Treidum]]).<ref name="ANH" /> It was considered fashionable among the Imperial officer class at the time.<ref name="The Jedi Academy Sourcebook">''[[The Jedi Academy Sourcebook]]''</ref> Many Imperials had their hair cropped tightly.<ref name="Razor's Edge">''[[Razor's Edge]]''</ref> [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] like [[Merumeru/Legends|Merumeru]] or [[Guanta/Legends|Guanta]] also tended to fashion their hair into several braids that were held in place by metal fastenings.<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

In the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], hairstyle was used as an indicator of status. While [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan apprentices]] of the haired species would often wear short cropped hairstyles, their masters would have long hair worn tightly back to keep vision clear in action.<ref name="Episode I: The Visual Dictionary" />

Hairless species would sometimes create the illusion of hair as a fashion statement. Some [[Lafrarian]]s, a race of avian [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] from the planet [[Lafra]], used "thickening agents" to make their head feathers appear similar to hair,<ref name="AE" /> while some Hutts like [[Marlo/Legends|Marlo]] used live [[Sha'rellian toop/Legends|sha'rellian toops]] as wigs.<ref name="Evil Plans">{{TCW|Evil Plans}}</ref>
